title: [PM seat] domain:spec · seat 2 — ⏳ vacant
body:
## Current PM

⏳ **vacant.** Signed off 2026-10-03T15:47Z on the maintainer's word in this seat's chat, verbatim: 「当前任务处理完就下班」 (recorded `5969273857`). Successor: `/pm-dispatch spec 2` (or `/pm-dispatch 接手`), after reading this body and the stand-down brief (the final comment on this post). The brief is the release marker, so a successor may sit at once.

- **Previous occupant:** `os-tesla`, session `session_01YDt3PzwfrkuFzUBF89WPmM`, seated 2026-10-02T04:41Z. **31 landings this shift** (the ledger below). It left nothing in flight:
  - no dev or review subagent running, and no cloud dev session;
  - no `pm:dispatched` card assigned to `os-tesla`;
  - one open PR of this seat, PR #21577 (draft), handed over with #21564, which stays `pm:blocked` on #21485 (release `5970515653`);
  - the hourly Routine `trig_011U3Dp3heByp7wVavvuEXBd` is **deleted**, and no `send_later` is pending.
- **Terms that applied to this occupant** (they end with it; a successor takes the maintainer's terms afresh): p0–p3 (「只处理 p0 p1 p2」, widened by 「p3 的卡也可以派了」, `5952442849`), `batch 3` (「任务很多，并发保持3」, `5945657799`), the maintainer-direct takeover of #20234 (「20234 你接手」, `5967611924`, released `5970436654`), and the close order (`5969273857`). ⛔ This seat performed no release act.
- **Tier:** ⛔ not at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. Contract-review records come from isolated at-tier subagents.
- **Charter:** `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/spec.md`.
- **Previous shift:** `os-bill` · `session_017VaLJnYwhPsanVCe9dMCJU` (brief `5941408213`). Its ledger is an earlier revision of this body.

## Handover ledger

- **Landed this shift:**
  - #20274 → PR #21280 → `135daaa06b` (`Part of #20274`; landing `5945738955`);
  - #21289 → PR #21353 → `23365eaedf` (landing `5947151738`);
  - #21261 → PR #21344 → `39119014dc` (landing `5947920127`). Its objectui half, objectstack-ai/objectui#11439, stays `pm:blocked` until a published `@objectstack/spec` release carries the change.
  - #21277 → PR #21367 → `3937ad2f32` (landing `5948520307`). The stale reconciliation `omit` row it left became #21374 (filed by this seat; triage graded it p2, `5948883894`).
  - #21374 → PR #21398 → `ca0dfb658a` (landing `5952122534`): the agent form offers `structuredOutput`, and the stale row is gone.
  - #20274's `agent.memory` half → PR #21413 → `22c2d6f4d5` (landing `5954753152`). #20274 is released to `pm:blocked` on #21320, its last key, and closes when that lands. Skills twin: #21415.
  - #20301 stage 2 → PR #21423 → `bdd3654f29` (landing `5955523783`): the card closed. The container `name` is kept `dead` with a corrected note, and the residue walks are gone. #21412 carries the divergence and the `view.zod.ts` comment rider (`5954896314`).
  - #20827 → PR #21390 → `c52c49d96e` (landing `5950858469`). Its skills twin is #21392 (`domain:skills`, filed by this seat), and the two should ship in the same release.
  - #21397 → PR #21408 → `68c5ab7eba` (landing `5955881319`): the null-ordering refusal names only existing faces, and both refusals say only what was measured.
  - #21421 → PR #21433 → `c2c21f357c` (landing `5957265590`): the liveness hook's tombstone describe gets its case budget. The PR was test-only, so this seat reviewed it (no contract tier owed).
  - #21326 stage 1 → PR #21453 → `57cc695062` (landing `5960164329`): ADR-0128 D1–D3 with a versioned handle. 18 of 18 files blob-equal. The card went back to `pm:queue` and was then re-claimed by this seat for stage 2.
  - #20871 → PR #21451 → `cfa4d740b7` (landing on the card): page `requires` is `live`. 8 of 10 files are blob-equal; the other two moved on `main` and carry an identical patch-id. The decision card #21459 is not waited on.
  - #20749 stage 1 → PR #21462 → `7e7e64b13d` (landing `5961738190`): the nine flow, hook, action and expression rule files state each decision in words. 20 of 20 files are blob-equal. The ledger reads 174, 51 of them in `packages/lint`.
  - #20749 stage 2 → PR #21491 → `15b29d37af` (landing `5963798253`). 25 of 25 files are blob-equal. `packages/lint` now has no row in the prose-id ledger (85 occurrences left, all in other lanes).
  - #21320 → PR #21461 → `6e33b67912` (Tier H; approved by `os-zhuang`, review `5397364956`): `agent.lifecycle` is retired and the XState `StateMachineSchema` family is gone. 56 of 63 files are blob-equal; the other 7 carry an identical patch-id. **#20274 closed `completed`** with all five keys settled (`5962719331`).
  - #21326 stage 2 → PR #21469 → `0557c2f674`: `os secret rewrap`, the at-rest rewrap. 13 of 13 files are blob-equal. The card's accepted scope is complete.
  - #21458 (p1) → PR #21479 → `72217cd6ff` (landing `5962952993`): `ApprovalActionRow.acted_as`. 3 of 3 files are blob-equal. A pointer is on #21411 for its consumer PR.
  - #21515 (p2) → PR #21538 → `f1e4ae56ad` (landing `5965994394`): `JobSchema.body` (L2, by reference), `handler` deprecated, one time limit. 9 of 9 files are blob-equal, and the card closed. The build lowering goes to decision #21540. #21489 got its unblock pointer (`5966006395`).
  - #21459 (p3, ruled A) → PR #21547 → `72af58c621` (landing `5966318417`): page `requires` only on `html` / `jsx`, refused at parse elsewhere, with stored rows stripped by a D2 conversion. 13 of 13 files are blob-equal, and the card closed.
  - #20749 stage 4 → PR #21555 → `e901c27449` (landing `5966666987`): the 56 protocol 16 → 17 conversion summaries and three descriptions in form D. 8 of 9 files are blob-equal, and 1 has an identical patch-id.
  - **#21500 (p1)** → PR #21535 → `41b13331cd` (landing `5965857282`): a view container's `form` is its default form. It is never collapsed into a named form, and no named form is promoted. 22 of 22 files are blob-equal, and the card closed `completed`. HotCRM's Create Lead dialog serves the intake form once a spec release carries it.
  - #20749 stage 3 → PR #21521 → `ad7c351898` (landing `5964915544`): `packages/spec`'s 13 author-visible refusals state each decision in words. 11 of 11 files are blob-equal. **The card was released to `pm:queue`** for stage 4, with the census and the stage plan in the landing.
  - #21504 → PR #21531 → `48eb9c193f` (landing `5965532071`): `ai:chat_window` is retired and refused by name, on the `user:profile` precedent. 22 of 22 files are blob-equal, and the card closed `completed`. objectui's two tests that will flip at its spec bump are named in the landing.
  - #21464 stage 1 → PR #21502 → `529d9711fb` (landing `5964405985`): `navigation` typed on map, gantt and tree, plus the enumeration pin `component-props-unknown-members.pin.test.ts`. 6 of 6 files are blob-equal. The card stays with this seat for its S-list stage.
  - **#21517 (p3)** → PR #21556 → `f83d0669d7` (**Tier H**, approved by `os-zhuang`, review `5399501462`; landing `5966890345`): three approval-actor texts, among them ADR-0042 §2's "superseded in part by ADR-0118 D1". 4 of 4 files are blob-equal, and the card closed `completed`.
  - **#21464 stage 2, S-list (p2)** → PR #21559 → `7d674dfc96` (landing `5967725407`): eight list members take the shape each block reads. 9 of 9 files are blob-equal. object-grid `columns` is held (FAIL record `5966757164`: the grid's group headers draw `columns[].options`), and its carrier is objectstack-ai/objectui#11544. The card stays with this seat.
  - #20749 stage 5 → PR #21568 → `a3873542ca` (landing `5967865492`): the 35 protocol 17 → 18 conversion summaries in form D. 2 of 2 files are blob-equal. Class (b) is empty.
  - **#20234 stage 11** (maintainer-direct takeover) → PR #21578 → `0bddffd55b` (landing `5968799418`): `migrations/registry.ts`'s hand-written parts hold no dead citation. 3 of 3 files are blob-equal. The 192 live rationale numbers moved to #20749 (`5968461965`).
  - #21464 stage 3 (S-form) → PR #21590 → `958cfe29be` (landing `5970139460`): four `object-form` members typed. 9 of 9 files are blob-equal. Four form members are held, carried by objectstack-ai/objectui#11550, and `customFields` is re-staged (`5969669440`).
  - #20749 stage 6 → PR #21593 → `f6b7520839` (landing `5970503314`): the 58 conformance-case notes in form D, with both test seams. 11 of 11 files are blob-equal. Class (c) is empty.
  - **#21565 (p2)** → PR #21592 → `9e9d693468` (landing `5970710988`); the card closed `completed`: `HookSchema` refuses a body hook that targets a stored-metadata table, by the runtime's own predicate and prescription. Reviewed on `478e3647`; the merge round's delta was read by the seat (`5970419770`).
- **Released at this close** (each with its state and next stage):
  - #20234 → `pm:queue` (`5970436654`). Next: the six dead numbers from the census pointer `5923089344`.
  - #21464 → `pm:queue` (`5970447305`). Next: S-metric, then S-objectui-held. Holds: the four form members (objectstack-ai/objectui#11550), grid `columns` (objectstack-ai/objectui#11544) and kanban `conditionalFormatting`.
  - #20749 → `pm:queue` (`5970503314`). Next: class (f) (17 registry rationales), `migrations/registry.ts`'s live rationale numbers (step 17, then step 18), and the test strings.
  - #21564 → stays `pm:blocked` on #21485 (`5970515653`). PR #21577 is ready, and lands after #21485 with a merge of `main` and a job-log reading.
- **#21572, carried by `domain:cli`:** this seat released it to triage (`5969155340`) after measuring that the spec row alone turns 6 `cli` / `runtime` tests red. Triage staged it to ride #21492's one landing (`5969348039`), and the `domain:cli` seat claimed both cards (`5969480247` on #21492, `5969484109` on #21572), starting from this seat's row commit `d480ef0d70` (declaration `5969505914`).
- **A container restart** killed three devs mid-run. Each had pushed its branch: two resumed from the pushed head with a resume note (any gate without a recorded exit code re-run), and the third had already posted its report.
- **#17306 went to seat 1** (claim `5947914088`, 2026-10-02T08:08Z), ahead of this seat's claim. This seat left its readings there as a pointer (`5947942746`): the step (1) rows do not exist; the `inlineHelpText` translation key is ruled by #7646 `5253154523`; PR #21344 landed on its files after its base.
- **Queue p0–p3 not taken:**
  - #18164 is a coordination node; #14122 is `tracking`.
  - #20281 (p3, older than #20871) has no spec-lane half left: stage ① landed, stage ② is #20919 (`domain:services`, closed), stage ③ is the job cadence. ⚠ A half-state for triage: it was relabelled `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue` at 2026-10-01T08:00Z with no paired comment, and its body still carries the spent `Blocked-by: #20919`.
  - The candidate rule excludes the `tooling` card #21295 (no `Unblocks:` line, no guarded published surface).
  - #21439 (p2) went to seat 1 (claim `5958894736`, 2026-10-02T18:37Z).
  - #21359 (p3, `bug`): `release.yml`'s backfill race, unlocked by triage `5948759273`. Read at this refresh: `release.yml` is outside the governed register, so the PR would be ordinary. It waits for a free slot behind the p2 and maintainer-direct work in flight.
  - #20471 (p3): quoted first lines for the `ComponentPropsMap` objectui anchors. It lands in `ui/component.zod.ts`, so it is serial behind #21504 and #21464's stages.
  - On hold, restart not met: #21158 (p1), whose probe reads 0 `authRequired: false` in objectstack `examples` and whose hotcrm half is out of reach; #5082 (p2), which waits for the protocol-18 train.
- **Decision box (this seat's):**
  - **#21540: ruled C and closed `completed`** (record `5968961157`, maintainer 「同意c」 on batch #273; director pointer `5968976782`). The build lowering is withdrawn: a job `body` is authored as data, and `os build` only validates it. Nothing is owed from this lane. This seat's decision box is empty at close.
  - Batch #270 ruled the earlier two (director pointer `5964354166`): #21326 → B, closed (the ADR-0128 landing note is held for the maintainer's own approval), and #21459 → A, now PR #21547.
- **Raised to the maintainer in chat, not carded:** ADR-0078 § 4 and its first Non-goal ("No hard Zod `.refine()` …") trail two rulings that put a parse refusal before the author-time rule (the `reference` door, and #20827's). `docs/adr/**` is Tier H.
- **Filed this shift:** objectstack-ai/objectui#11550 (plugin-form draws `{ name }` field entries and inline runtime-field section entries that objectstack's form view refuses; the page-builder guide teaches the field form; it carries #21464's four form holds), objectstack-ai/objectui#11544 (the grid's group headers read `columns[].options`, which `ListColumnSchema` refuses; it holds #21464's `columns`), #21540 (the job build-lowering decision, above), #21537 (the `objectstack-ui` skill's create/edit form examples under `formViews`, a twin of PR #21535, Tier H), objectstack-ai/objectui#11539 (`applyViewItem`'s first-form fallback), #21277, #21288, #21289, objectstack-ai/objectui#11439, #21374, #21392, #21412, #21415, #21457 (an objectql test loads the package barrel inside a 5 s window; from the #21326 dev report), #21459 (the decision card above), #21504 (`ai:chat_window`, declared with no renderer; triage ruled retire), objectstack-ai/objectui#11522 (kanban's second `conditionalFormatting` dialect, which blocks #21464's held member), #21471 (`os secret orphans`, a report that writes nothing, can create a dev key file; escalated by review `5962153191`).
- **Director pointer `5945675083`:** fully executed. `agent.memory` landed as PR #21413, and `agent.lifecycle` landed as PR #21461 (#21320). #20274 closed `completed`.

## Hot-file serial queue

⛔ Re-derive this from the live `Claim:` comments and each open PR's actual file list before every dispatch, across BOTH spec seats.

- **This seat holds no claims at close.** Its last regions (`ui/component.zod.ts` and the enumeration pin, `data/hook.zod.ts` and the kernel leaf, the class-(c) conformance modules, `migrations/registry.ts`) are all landed and released.
- **Seat 1 (#6017) is vacant** since 2026-10-03T00:09Z, and its regions are released. 
- **`content/docs/references/**`** is `merge=os-regen`: use `bash scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`. ⚠ Corrected: `migrations/registry.ts` is NOT driver-managed (`.gitattributes` keeps it so, because it mixes hand-written and generated regions). `check:migration-registry` judges a text merge of it.

## Notes

- **Publication:** objectstack. A merge to `main` publishes nothing. The release is the Version Packages PR (#21352), a human act.
- **Write channel:** the `fleet-write` relay (route `dispatch`), read back on every write.
- **Receipts read through `5969505914`:**
  - the director's pointer `5968976782` (#21540 ruled C, closed);
  - `domain:cli#1`'s declaration `5969245751`: PR #21584 carries `packages/spec/liveness/job.json` and its counts. This seat raises no objection, and the PR has landed as `6c5697dffb`. Its §2 pointer named two `job.zod.ts` texts the landing would make false; PR #21584 corrected both itself, as read on `main`, so nothing is owed;
  - `domain:cli#1`'s declaration `5969505914`: #21572 rides #21492, as above.
  - Earlier: the director's pointer for batch #270. It carried #21459 → A, #21326 → B (closed), and the new card #21515, which this seat claimed (`5964760101`). Earlier: the `domain:engine` seat's cross-lane declaration on #21412 and #21457, answered on #21457 (`5961811176`). Skill touch: `SKILL.md` unchanged at `9dae4752e0`.
- **Platform fact seen this shift:** a relay `issue_patch` of a PR body without a footer stored identical and appended NO bare footer. `platform-readings.md` lines 345-348 say a footer is appended. This goes in the shift brief for `domain:skills`.
- **Triage gap noted:** #17306 carries no `area:*` label.
